title: #1 Ghost Tour in the Midwest : Candlelight Trolley Tour
blurb:
Climb aboard Minneapolis’ Candlelight Ghost Trolley Tour for a wickedly fun night of haunted history, paranormal legends, and eerie storytelling through the city’s darkest corners. Departing from the infamous haunted Pillsbury Club, guests can arrive early to explore the Halloween market, grab food, and relax in exclusive VIP lounges before the spirits come out to play.

Led by expert storytellers-you’ll ride through Minneapolis aboard a historic trolley rumored to be haunted itself, hearing chilling tales of ghostly apparitions, cursed mansions, unsolved mysteries, and the strange figures still said to wander the streets after dark.

Armed with flickering candlelight you’ll experience one of Minneapolis’ top-rated nighttime attractions and a year-round Halloween event that’s equal parts spooky, theatrical, and wildly entertaining.
